   - **#0017 stays.** #0118 cancels #0106, so #0050 holds and cancels #0035.

   - **#0458 is removed.** #1381 cancels #1121, so #0848 holds and removes #0458.

4. **Applying the rest:** every remaining Finance increase and decrease was applied once, in order, from $1380K. The final entry, #1597 (+$150K), brings the total to $1874K. This was a single running total; I did not do a separate second check of the sum.
